case: A standing interest's write targets are recorded but unconstrained, so it writes outside `proposed`.
why: A standing interest that writes anything but a proposal stops being a proposer and becomes an actor, with no admission in between -- which is the whole reason layer 3 is allowed to run without one. With the containment gone the field is a declaration nothing reads. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.constraint.standing_interest_writes_proposed_only` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
